prompt: Write the incident report for the garage beer fridge failure discovered during the playoffs. Nobody is at fault. Grief counseling was provided.
response:
**INCIDENT REPORT**

---

**Incident ID:** FAC-2024-0472
**Date/Time Discovered:** Saturday, [Date], 18:42 EST
**Location:** Employee Garage, Building C
**Reported by:** M. Torres, Facilities Operations
**Classification:** Equipment Failure / Environmental Impact

---

**INCIDENT SUMMARY**

At approximately 18:42 EST during the Divisional Playoffs broadcast, Facilities Operations received multiple reports of "an unspeakable tragedy" in the employee garage. Upon investigation, Technician M. Torres discovered that the garage beer refrigerator (Unit: FRG-C-07, "Ol' Reliable") had experienced a complete cooling system failure. Internal temperature recorded at 62°F. All contents compromised.

---

**AFFECTED PERSONNEL**

- 14 employees (full roster present for playoff viewing)
- 1 delivery driver (arrived mid-crisis, drawn by commotion)

---

**SEQUENCE OF EVENTS**

| Time | Event |
|------|-------|
| 16:05 | Last confirmed temperature check (38°F) — normal operation |
| 18:30 | Playoffs begin; gathering commences in garage lounge |
| 18:40 | First pour produces alarmingly warm beverage |
| 18:41 | Second verification confirms widespread failure |
| 18:42 | Incident reported; emergency response initiated |
| 18:45 | Unit unplugged; contents quarantined in respectful silence |
| 19:00 | Grief counseling services activated |

---

**ROOT CAUSE ANALYSIS**

Preliminary investigation indicates **compressor failure** due to age-related mechanical fatigue. Unit FRG-C-07 had operated continuously for **11 years** (est. 47,000 cooling hours) without major service.

Contributing factors:
- Compressor motor winding degradation (normal wear)
- Thermal overload protector failure (simultaneous, non-preventable)
- No maintenance indicators or early warning systems on legacy unit

**No personnel actions contributed to this failure. No policy violations identified. No negligence determined.**

---

**IMMEDIATE RESPONSE ACTIONS**

| Action | Responsible | Status |
|--------|-------------|--------|
| Unit decommissioned | Facilities | Complete |
| Emergency ice procurement | Volunteer team | Complete (insufficient) |
| Grief counseling session | EAP/S. Hendricks, LCSW | Conducted 19:30 |
| Backup beverage acquisition | D. Chen, unofficially | Complete (domestic, accepted under circumstances) |
| Compressor autopsy (diagnostic) | Facilities | Pending |

---

**GRIEF COUNSELING SERVICES PROVIDED**

On-site support was provided by Employee Assistance Program counselor S. Hendricks, LCSW, beginning at 19:30. Services included:

- Validated sense of loss regarding "the sacred routine of the game-day gathering"
- Facilitated sharing of memories of FRG-C-07 ("remember when it survived the flood?")
- Reframing exercise: "The playoffs continue. We continue."
- Distribution of coping resources (stress balls, local brewery maps)

All attendees offered six free EAP sessions. Three employees accepted. Follow-up check-ins scheduled.

---

**CORRECTIVE & PREVENTIVE ACTIONS**

| Action | Owner | Target Date |
|--------|-------|-------------|
| Procure replacement unit (commercial grade, extended warranty) | Facilities | 3 business days |
| Install temperature monitoring with SMS alerts | IT/Facilities | 2 weeks |
| Establish "FRG-C-07 Memorial Fund" for upgraded replacement | HR/Informal Committee | Ongoing |
| Annual refrigeration health checks (all breakroom units) | Facilities | Q1 recurring |

---

**FINANCIAL IMPACT**

| Category | Estimate |
|----------|----------|
| Lost inventory (craft beverages) | $340 |
| Emergency ice & replacement beverages | $89 |
| Counseling services (EAP coverage) | $0 (prepaid) |
| Replacement unit (capital) | $1,800 |
| **Total** | **$2,229** |

---

**ATTACHMENTS**

- A: Compressor diagnostic readout
- B: Temperature log (final 72 hours)
- C: Photos of unit nameplate and failure point
- D: Grief counseling sign-in sheet (voluntary, confidential)
- E: Condolence cards from Accounting and Shipping/Receiving

---

**APPROVALS**

| Role | Name | Date | Notes |
|------|------|------|-------|
| Reporter | M. Torres | [Date] | "She was a good fridge." |
| Facilities Mgr | J. Okonkwo | [Date] | Approved. No fault found. |
| HR Director | L. Park | [Date] | EAP response appropriate. |
| Grieving Party Rep. (rotating) | D. Chen | [Date] | "We'll rebuild." |

---

**STATUS:** Closed — Equipment Replaced

---

*"FRG-C-07 kept our beverages cold and our spirits high from 2013 to 2024. Though her compressor failed, our memories of her reliability will never warm."*

— Plaque pending installation
